home_description: Welcome to St. George's Orthodox Church, a vibrant community of faith rooted in the ancient traditions of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church.
We invite you to join us in worship, fellowship, and service as we grow together in Christ.
home_story: St. George's Orthodox Church was established to serve the spiritual needs of the Orthodox Christian community.
Over the decades, our parish has grown into a thriving community committed to preserving our rich liturgical heritage while reaching out to the wider community.
We are blessed with dedicated clergy and laity who work together in love and unity.

vicars.name: Rev. Fr. Sample Priest
vicars.profile: Fr. Sample Priest has served the parish with dedication since his appointment. He holds a degree in theology from the Orthodox Theological Seminary.

vicars.name: Rev. Fr. Former Priest
vicars.profile: Fr. Former Priest served the parish faithfully for many years, building a strong foundation for the community.

service_info: Holy Qurbana is celebrated every Sunday at 9:00 AM. Special services are held on all major feast days of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church. Please contact the vicar for details on baptisms, weddings, and other sacraments.
